text: The mileage stored in the instrument cluster and its backup copy in another module don't agree.
DSC is not getting the data it expects from the engine computer over the CAN bus.
hint: Often logged after a low or disconnected battery or engine computer work; clear it and see if it returns.

text: Power supply fault on terminal 30g_f, a switched battery feed the junction box controls.
hint: Commonly logged after low battery voltage or the car sitting for a long time.

text: Condensation (fogging) sensor at the base of the rear-view mirror reports a fault.
hint: Check the sensor and its connector behind the mirror cover.
